# Yankı

> Yankı mirrors your own words back, names what you appear to feel, and offers one small next step. It is a companion, not therapy, and it never invents a feeling you did not put there.

Yankı is an emotional check-in companion, not therapy, not a diagnosis, not a medical device.
Reflections are produced by Anthropic's Messages API with claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 under a JSON-only prompt;
crisis wording is decided by a rule list before the model is called.

## Pages

- [Product](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/): what it does and a live demo box
- [How it works](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/how-it-works/): the five steps of a check-in
- [Safety](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/safety/): explicit limits, emergency notice (112 in Türkiye)
- [Privacy](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/privacy/): text is not stored during the beta; no analytics cookie
- [Company](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/company/): identity, roadmap with status, verification links
- [API](https://mevlanayalcin.com.tr/api/): POST /api/reflect contract, errors, rate limit, budget guard

## Facts kept separate on purpose

- mevlanayalcin.com.tr is a personal domain held since September 2023.
- Product work on Yankı began October 2026.
- One person, bootstrapped, Ankara. No registered legal entity, no funding raised, no customers yet.
- Waitlist only: sign-up at the site; deletion by email to merhaba@mevlanayalcin.com.tr.
